sentences.text: The above writ petition challenges the order dated 28.08.2023, passed by the Competent Authority and the Sub-Divisional Officer, Kalyan, Sub-Division Office, Kalyan in respect of the acquisition of land bearing Gat No. 2/4/B situated at Nilaje, Taluka-Kalyan, District-Thane.

By the impugned order passed under section 77 of the Right to Fair Compensation And Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, the application filed by the Petitioners objecting to the disbursement of compensation to Respondent No.1, was rejected.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation And Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013

sentences.text: The matter has been moved for urgent ad-interim relief as there is an apprehension that the amount awarded for the acquisition of the said land would be disbursed, if no orders are obtained from this Court.
Mrs. Bane, the learned AGP waives notice on behalf of Respondent No.2/State.

The Registry is directed to issue notice to Respondent Nos. 1, 3, 4 and 5, returnable on 28.11.2023.
4.
In addition to the Court's notice, the Petitioners are permitted to serve the said Respondent by private notice as well.
5. In the meanwhile, the Competent Authority is directed not to disburse any amount under the impugned order, if not already disbursed.
This order will be digitally signed by the Private Secretary/ Personal Assistant of this Court.
All concerned will act on production by fax or email of a digitally signed copy of this order.
